title: 국군수송사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text: Article 3 (Appointment of Commander and Other Officials) The Command shall have one Commander and one Chief of Staff; the Commander shall be appointed from among general officers, and the Chief of Staff from among field-grade officers. <Amended on Sep. 5, 2017>
